name: Natsuiro Sailtrim
original_name: ナツイロセールトリム
source:
A novel work themed on one type of a yacht race called "sailing".

Set in Enoshima in Shonan area, schoolgirls challenge sailing!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE226538.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
以一种名为“帆船”的游艇比赛为主题的小说。

以湘南江之岛为背景，女学生挑战航海！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE226538.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
